اعتمروا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَرُوا (iʕtamarū) /iʕ.ta.ma.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اُعْتُمِرُوا (uʕtumirū) /uʕ.tu.mi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اِعْتَمِرُوا (iʕtamirū) /iʕ.ta.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
